summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad, with aliases, docs, and tests. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gets Lambda appended at the end (asserts callable func, stores only func, no base init call). monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py gets the typing line changed to Callable, Optional (Optional is still needed by DataStatsd), a Lambda import, the Lambdad class between ConcatItemsd and the alias block, and the LambdaD/LambdaDict alias line. docs/source/transforms.rst gets Lambda before SplitChannel and Lambdad before Transform Adaptors. New tests: tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py cover identity and slicing callables. Not run: per instructions I did not run tests, flake8, or black; line lengths were checked by grep against the 120-character limit. Nothing is committed.
